author: salvatoreliotta
quote: Worst GTA so far. It is political, basic story, free world is boring, driving ****, and the missions are an absolute joke. Then no online yet so as the game gets destroyed by older fans( the ones with money) we will hate it so much that we will forget about GTA6 online and keep just playing GTA5 until you close it down.
